en.summary: Fixes miss-reservation backpressure so the cache stops earlier instead of overcommitting the miss queue and locking the pipeline.
why_it_counts: The change is in the cache miss-reservation RTL, not in tests or infrastructure.
The patch directly adjusts the stop threshold that controls when new misses are throttled.
The inline comment states that the old threshold could cause pipeline lock.
disqualifiers: VX_bank.v only has whitespace movement in this commit.
evidence: VX_cache_miss_resrv.v changes miss_resrv_stop from size > MRVQ_SIZE-1 to size > MRVQ_SIZE-5.
The patched line adds a comment that five cycles of extra headroom are needed to prevent pipeline lock.
No non-DUT behavioral files are involved in the real fix.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: This fix corrects a classic queue-headroom bug in a miss reservation structure. The buggy form lets upstream stages continue launching misses until the reservation queue is almost or completely full, even though several in-flight pipeline stages can still allocate new entries before the stop signal takes effect. Under sustained miss pressure, that late backpressure can exhaust slack and lock the cache pipeline.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: A burst of misses arrives while the miss queue is approaching capacity and there are still several pipeline stages that can generate additional allocations before throttling takes effect.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Reduce or remove the safety headroom so the stop condition only fires at the very end of the queue.
portability_notes: This maps to any cache, MSHR, miss queue, or reservation queue that needs early backpressure because allocation is pipelined.
The important property is the slack between asserting stop and actually preventing all further allocations.
If the target queue has a different depth or latency, preserve the relative mistake: stop too late for the pipeline depth.
concrete_injection_steps: Identify the signal that stops new miss allocation when the reservation structure is nearly full.
Change the threshold so it trips only at full or one-entry-left instead of leaving several entries of pipeline headroom.
Do not change the actual full detection; only weaken the earlier stop condition.
Keep the rest of enqueue and dequeue logic unchanged so the fault manifests as late backpressure rather than a structural queue rewrite.

repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The commit moves miss_resrv_stop earlier, from MRVQ_SIZE-1 to MRVQ_SIZE-5, to restore enough pipeline headroom and avoid lockup.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: In VX_cache_miss_resrv, change miss_resrv_stop back to compare size against MRVQ_SIZE-1 instead of MRVQ_SIZE-5.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: The cache can accept misses too long, overrun its safety margin, and enter a deadlock or severe long stall under miss-heavy traffic.
evidence_for_injection: The only behavioral delta is the stop threshold in VX_cache_miss_resrv.v.
The added source comment explicitly ties the extra headroom to preventing pipeline lock.
The commit subject calls this a regression fix rather than a feature change.
notes: This is a very portable injection because it is just an almost-full threshold error.
Do not treat the whitespace-only VX_bank.v change as part of the bug.

zh.summary: 该修复把 miss reservation 的反压提前，避免 miss 队列被过度占满并导致流水线锁死。
why_it_counts: 改动位于 cache miss reservation RTL，而不是测试或基础设施。
补丁直接调整了控制何时停止接收新 miss 的阈值。
源代码注释明确写明旧阈值会导致 pipeline lock。
disqualifiers: 本提交中的 VX_bank.v 只有空白位置变化。
evidence: VX_cache_miss_resrv.v 把 miss_resrv_stop 从 size > MRVQ_SIZE-1 改为 size > MRVQ_SIZE-5。
修改后的代码行增加了注释，说明需要预留 5 个周期的额外空间来避免流水线锁死。
真正的修复没有涉及任何非 DUT 的行为文件。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 该修复针对 miss reservation 结构中非常典型的队列余量错误。缺陷版本让上游在队列几乎满甚至已满时才停止发射 miss，而在 stop 信号生效之前，后续若干级流水线仍然可能继续分配新条目。在持续 miss 压力下，这种过晚的反压会耗尽缓冲余量并锁死 cache pipeline。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: miss reservation 队列的反压余量
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 一串 miss 在 miss 队列接近容量上限时到来，同时前端流水线还有若干级可能继续分配新条目。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 减少或移除安全余量，使 stop 条件直到队列最后阶段才触发。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: 恢复过晚触发的 almost-full 阈值
portability_notes: 这可映射到任何因为分配路径有流水线延迟，而需要提前反压的 cache、MSHR、miss queue 或 reservation queue。
关键属性是：从发出 stop 到真正阻止所有后续分配之间存在若干周期的滞后。
如果目标队列深度或流水线长度不同，也应保持相同类型的错误，即 stop 相对流水线深度触发得过晚。
concrete_injection_steps: 找到在 reservation 结构接近满时用于停止新 miss 分配的信号。
把阈值改为只有在队列已满或只剩一个槽位时才触发，而不是提前预留多个条目。
不要改动真正的 full 检测，只削弱更早的 stop 条件。
其余 enqueue 和 dequeue 逻辑保持不变，让故障表现为反压过晚而不是队列结构本身被重写。

repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 该提交把 miss_resrv_stop 从 MRVQ_SIZE-1 提前到 MRVQ_SIZE-5，从而恢复足够的流水线余量并避免锁死。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 在 VX_cache_miss_resrv 中，把 miss_resrv_stop 改回与 MRVQ_SIZE-1 比较，而不是 MRVQ_SIZE-5。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 在 miss 很密集的场景下，cache 会过久地继续接收 miss，最终耗尽安全余量并进入死锁或长时间停顿。
evidence_for_injection: 唯一的行为修改就是 VX_cache_miss_resrv.v 中的 stop 阈值。
新增注释明确说明额外余量是为了防止 pipeline lock。
提交标题把它定义为 regression fix，而不是功能新增。
notes: 这个故障注入非常可移植，因为本质上只是一个 almost-full 阈值错误。
不要把 VX_bank.v 中仅有的空白变化当成缺陷的一部分。
